name: tri_mosaic
description: flat-shaded triangles nested inside triangles, large and calm far from the set and splitting ever finer towards it, each facet tilted and folded into three lit faces

reference.made_with: a recursive triangle tiling in navy, rust and cream, unsigned, 3200x1600

reuses: the smooth count through the matched map by rank at 2 cycles
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10, measured after the post stage
adds: the post stage: passes over the whole composited frame (engine/src/post.rs)
the mosaic pass: a triangle or log-polar quad lattice split where the set is, flat or turned fills, relief, fold, inlay and seams
notes: From wallhaven-47k2py and wallhaven-4xy8el (item 057), with technology-25, sun-disk-25 and pacific-shore-25 as further readings. The first style with a post stage: the base is one palette layer, and the mosaic pass does the rest.

The tiling is a Whitney-style cover: a cell splits in four while the least distance estimate under it is within `reach` of its edges, so cells halve as the set nears and the smallest (`smallest` 0.0018, 5 px at 2560) run along the lace. `largest` 0.5 with `reach` 0.7 keeps whole calm triangles in the far field; 0.25 with 1.0 (f_fine) reads as a finer, more even weave.

Shading: `fold` draws each facet as a low three-faced pyramid (4xy8el's cube corners), `relief` tilts it to the plane fitted through the picture's own luminance under it. A relief read off the smooth count needs about 40 to show; at 12 it is flat.
Tone held at all 40 scouted drafts (`--max-ink 0.10`) as first fitted. The first map missed p90 low (0.74 against 0.88) until its cream took the top third.

`inlay` draws a calm facet's own children into it as faint lighter and darker cells (47k2py's nested texture) without splitting it: f_inlay is flat facets, seams and a three-level inlay at 0.07, the closest reading of that reference.

Round one's other readings, as formulations: f_flat (seams only), f_fold, f_detail (`reach` 0, `detail` 0.05: cells follow the picture's bands, not the set), f_shards (pacific-shore: turned fills on a tilted lattice), f_spiral and f_spiral_split (technology, sun-disk: turned quads of the `spiral` lattice, at spiral seats), and the entry tri_mosaic_ice (4xy8el's blues, tone 0.629/0.176), unkept until a tile is.
Tried and dropped: a `copies` fill (the frame's middle shrunk into every facet) drew noise at every depth and left the engine; a flat-filled spiral lattice reads as mush beside the triangles.
Not catalogued yet: the row (lab tier) lands with Matt's score. Until then `style wasm-parity` draws this file at `style_wasm.POST_SEAT`.
